# Contributing

Report bugs with the calculator, inputs, expected result, actual result, browser
and language. Include a formula or technical source when changing calculations.
Keep product codes, material keys, units and thread standards stable unless a
technical change explicitly requires it. Preserve host-page CSS isolation.

Open focused pull requests, update relevant documentation and run the documented
checks. Keep credentials, customer information and internal business documents
out of commits. Contributions are submitted under this repository's MIT license.
SmiCut reviews contributions before merging into the official version.

Use the [reference map](../docs/calculations/README.md) to update calculation and
CNC documentation with code changes. Keep examples consistent with effective
overrides, rounding and copied results. Do not regenerate oracle data from app
output simply to make tests pass.

Follow the [publication policy](../docs/publication-policy.md) before adding
reference material or release assets. Check confidentiality and redistribution
rights. Private trials, commercial terms and unreleased prototypes do not belong
in public commits or pull requests. Public reference prices remain permitted.
